title: Link skill
wikitext:
'''Links''' are [[active skill]]s that create a bond between your character and a specific [[party]] member, providing a benefit to them while they stay in range. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. Link skills cannot be [[trigger]]ed or used by [[Totem]]s, [[Trap]]s, or [[Mine]]s.

==Skill functions and interactions==
*'''Multiple Links''': It is possible for a character to link to multiple targets.<ref name="MultipleTargets"/> Two characters cannot both simultaneously be linked to each other.<ref name="SingleLink"/> Casting a new link on a target will replace your previous links on that target. Link skills will attempt to target non-linked targets before refreshing existing links.
*'''[[Duration]]''': Modifiers to duration will affect the duration of the link. Links will break prematurely if the target leaves their [[range]] or line of sight for 4 seconds; this can occur often with extremely slow [[minion]]s.
*'''[[Cost]]''': Link skills have a [[mana]] cost per second for their [[duration]], which can be affected by cost modifiers. Effects that specify ''upfront'' costs do not work with per-second costs. The cost must be paid for each active link to another target. If the character is unable to pay the cost, all links will break. 
*'''[[Minion]]s''': The [[Minion Defence Mastery]] allows the character to link to damageable minions. Minions linked this way expiring naturally by running out of duration or if being resummoned count as them dying and thus '''will''' cause the caster to die. An exception however are [[Manifest Dancing Dervishes|Dancing Dervishes]] summoned by {{il|The Dancing Dervish}}. The player running out of [[rampage]] causes the Dancing Dervishes to vanish which does not count as them dying.

Due to the limited methods to scale the buff effect of link skills, they benefit greatly from gem levels, such as via {{il|Pragmatism}} or {{il|Voideye}}. The [[Luminary]] ascendancy's {{psl|Golden Glory}} also enables link buff effect to be scaled by [[light radius]], an otherwise mostly useless stat.

==Skill gems==
There are {{Drop enabled gem count||where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Link"}} skill gems with the [[:Category:Link (gem tag)|Link]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Link"
}}

==Unique items==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%link skill%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%linked target%"
|level=1
|stat=1
|large=1
}}

==Related passive skills==
===Passive skills===
The following [[passive skill]]s are related to Link skills:
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%link%"
AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%brequel%"
}}

===Keystone passive skills===
The following [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to Link skills:

{{Query keystone passive skills
|q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Link%"
     AND passive_skills.is_keystone = 1
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Link skills:
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%link%" AND mastery_effects.stat_text_raw NOT LIKE "%blink%"}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
The following [[Ascendancy passive skill]]s are related to Link skills:
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Link%"
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%link skill%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}
